modules.text:
Connect Teams is a team collaboration and project management platform built with modern full-stack technologies.

It brings messaging, task tracking, and project organization into a single workflow for distributed teams.

modules.title: The Challenge
modules.text:
Teams need a unified platform for collaboration that combines communication, task management, and project tracking without unnecessary complexity.

The solution needed real-time updates, concurrent usage, and strong data integrity guarantees.

modules.title: Architecture & Tech Stack
modules.text:
Built with a React + TypeScript frontend for a responsive UI and type-safe development.

Node.js + Express backend with PostgreSQL for relational data and Redis for caching and real-time updates.

Containerized with Docker with a deployment setup that can be adapted to managed container platforms.

modules.title: Core Features
modules.text:
Real-time messaging with WebSocket integration for instant notifications.

Task management with status tracking, assignments, and deadline management.

Project organization with team collaboration spaces, file sharing, and activity feeds.

modules.title: Deployment & DevOps
modules.text:
Containerized with Docker across dev/staging/prod environments.

A CI/CD pipeline automates build, test, and deployment steps to keep releases repeatable and low-risk.

The setup can be integrated with Infrastructure as Code depending on the target cloud environment.

modules.title: Security & Performance
modules.text:
Uses JWT-based authentication and follows OWASP-aligned security practices (input validation, secure defaults, least privilege).

Redis caching reduces repetitive database work, and soft-delete patterns help preserve auditability and data integrity.
